definitions.explanation: Vegetables that are in season during summer, such as tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, and bell peppers.

examples.japanese: {夏野菜|なつやさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's the season when summer vegetables are delicious.

examples.japanese: {夏野菜|なつやさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a curry using lots of summer vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧{夏野菜|なつやさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧おすそ{分|わ}け⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I shared some of the summer vegetables I grew in my garden with my neighbors.

notes:
{夏野菜|なつやさい} refers to vegetables that are in season during summer. A compound of ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ (summer) + ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (vegetables).

TYPICAL SUMMER VEGETABLES:
- ⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧: tomato
- きゅうり: cucumber
- なす: eggplant
- ⟦ピーマン→ピーマン：11132_piiman⟧: bell pepper
- ⟦とうもろこし→とうもろこし：10394_toumorokoshi⟧: corn
- ⟦オクラ→オクラ：10242_okura⟧: okra
- ゴーヤ: bitter melon

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {夏野菜|なつやさい}⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧: summer vegetable curry (a popular dish)
- {夏野菜|なつやさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揚|あ}げ→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧びたし: deep-fried summer vegetables in broth
- {夏野菜|なつやさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use lots of summer vegetables

SEASONAL TERMS:
- {春野菜|はるやさい}: spring vegetables
- {冬野菜|ふゆやさい}: winter vegetables
- ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: vegetables in season
